source.scope: store-wide (NOT product-scoped) — an order belongs to Sonya if its same rule as salesuk.js: first-session utm_campaign or utm_term matches one of Sonya's confirmed values, OR (first session has no campaign/term AND the 2nd/LAST session's campaign is "Klarna_Sonya_kl-pmx-all"), OR (no campaign anywhere AND first-session utm_medium is "google_ads", unless the last session traces to a Sajeepan campaign).. Order-level rows (no per-product breakdown) with full session history. Groups are checked in a fixed priority order (DM-Ad -> Meta -> Sonya -> Sajeepan -> Sukirtha -> Kamsi -> Dilaksi -> Organic) so no order can appear in more than one group's tab. 2025 backfill using the exact same rules already confirmed on salesuk.html for 2026 — built 2026-07-29.
